reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Ilkka Paananen, Founder and CEO of Supercell, a mobile game developer based in Finland.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Ilkka Paananen, Founder and CEO of Supercell, a mobile game developer based in Finland. Supercell has built hugely successful games like Clash of Clans and Clash Royale that have reached over 100 million daily active users. What interests me most about the company is Supercell's unique culture built on decentralized, autonomous teams with nearly total creative control.

key_points.text: Ilkka and I talk about how Supercell hires and designs teams, why they incorporate as little process as possible, and the rise of global.
I hope you enjoy my conversation with Ilkka.
